hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
The Gabonese Bantu language Tombidi
(**hh:phon:Bingoumou:Ntumbidi**, **hh:w:Bingoumou:Ntumbidi**) is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29.  It is as distinct from all other Gabonese languages as any other Gabonese language included in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29
(**hh:hv:Alewijnseetal:Gabon**, **hh:hb:Idiata:Gabon**).
